title: Infrastructure as Code with Azure Bicep
description: Provision and automate enterprise Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Cosmos DB, and networking infrastructure idempotently using Azure Bicep.

data.text: Provisioning enterprise AI infrastructure manually via the Azure Portal ('ClickOps') is error-prone, impossible to audit, and fails to guarantee parity between development, staging, and production environments. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) treats cloud architecture as version-controlled software. In the Azure ecosystem, Azure Bicep is the native domain-specific language (DSL) providing first-class type safety, zero state-file drift headaches (unlike Terraform), and instant same-day support for new Azure OpenAI model versions.
Declarative Azure OpenAI & AI Search Bicep Module
The Bicep template below provisions an Azure OpenAI Cognitive Services account with a GPT-4o model deployment alongside an Azure AI Search service configured for semantic hybrid ranking.

data.title: Enterprise AI Infrastructure Template in Azure Bicep
data.content: Provisions Azure OpenAI, model deployment, and Azure AI Search with zero secrets:

data.text: By separating templates from environment parameters using .bicepparam files, your CI/CD pipeline deploys a lightweight dev configuration (lower capacity quotas, standard search SKU) during pull requests, while deploying high-capacity, multi-region PTU infrastructure to production.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Eliminate manual ClickOps: define all AI cloud resources declaratively in Azure Bicep
Bicep provides native Azure type validation without external state file management
Set disableLocalAuth: true to enforce passwordless Azure Managed Identity at the infrastructure layer
Model deployments (GPT-4o, embeddings) are codified as first-class child resources
Parameterize environments with .bicepparam files to scale quotas seamlessly from dev to prod
data.takeaway: Infrastructure as Code turns enterprise AI architecture into repeatable, auditable software. Using Azure Bicep guarantees consistent, secure environments across the entire development lifecycle.
